row.notes: Collects day param_2's entries (0x1407c6380, allocator +8); for each resolves the activity in the table +0x20 and returns false when its type (< 0x23) has its bit set in mask 0x7ffffbebb and entry byte +0xc == 0; true otherwise. Callers include Team HQ advance (0x1422c3540, 0x1422caed0). (lane owner review requested) Better name: Career_Schedule_Check_DayHasNoBlockingActivity (bound record keeps its name).

verify.notes: V9700 Predicate inverted: returns false when some event id IS in the set with kind in bitmask 0x7ffffbebb and event flag +0xc == 0; otherwise true.
